sections.title: The problem
sections.body:
English vocabulary is often taught as lists to memorise, which bores students quickly. Meanwhile, mind sports that train focus and strategic thinking get little support outside a few clubs.

INASA Scrabble Academy turns English Scrabble into a structured training path, from first game to tournament play.

items.title: Weekly training sessions
items.description: Word study, board strategy, and timed games for beginner to advanced players.

items.title: School programs
items.description: Introductory Scrabble clubs that help schools build English enrichment activities.

items.title: Tournament preparation
items.description: Coaching and practice games for regional and national competitions.

sections.body: Players report larger vocabularies and better focus, and the academy has helped grow a friendly, competitive Scrabble community.
